_info: HCT 1.6 podium: the game cars whose own driver gets off and takes the prize. The game models the driver into the car's body; on the podium the body is read from your installed game and split into its connected pieces, and every piece of MinTris-MaxTris triangles whose box centre lies in the driver's seat column (X and Z ranges, above MinY; metres, the car's own mesh space, +Z forward) goes when the figure gets off. Outfit 'auto' dresses the figure in the removed driver's colours; 'police' in a police uniform and cap. HasDriver false: nothing is removed (a closed car), only the outfit. Our own vehicles mark their driver in their OBJ instead ('g driver').
